definitions.explanation: The capacity for learning, reasoning, understanding, and similar forms of mental activity.

examples.japanese: {人工|じんこう}{知能|ちのう}の{研究|けんきゅう}が{進|すす}んでいる。
examples.english: Research on artificial intelligence is progressing.

examples.japanese: イルカは{知能|ちのう}が{高|たか}い{動物|どうぶつ}だ。
{知能|ちのう}テストを{受|う}けた。

notes:
COMMON COMPOUND WORDS:
・{人工|じんこう}{知能|ちのう} (artificial intelligence, AI)
・{知能|ちのう}テスト (intelligence test, IQ test)
・{知能|ちのう}{指数|しすう} (intelligence quotient, IQ)
・{知能|ちのう}{犯|はん} (intellectual crime, white-collar crime)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{知能|ちのう}: General mental ability, intelligence
・{知識|ちしき}: Knowledge, information one has learned
・{知恵|ちえ}: Wisdom, practical intelligence
